entries.title: Judges 12:1
segments: And the men of Ephraim were called together and went northward, and said to Jephthah, Why did you go over to fight against the sons of Ammon, and did not call us to go with you? We will burn your house upon you with fire.

entries.title: Judges 12:2
segments: And Jephthah said to them, My people and I were at great strife [with] the sons of Ammon. And when I called you, you did not deliver me out of their hands.

entries.title: Judges 12:3
segments: When I saw that you did not deliver me, I took my life in my hand and passed over against the sons of Ammon, and the LORD delivered them into my hand, and why have you come up against me, to fight against me today?

entries.title: Judges 12:4
segments: And Jephthah called up all the men of Gilead and fought with Ephraim. And the men of Gilead struck Ephraim, because they said, You Gileadites [are] fugitives of Ephraim among the Ephraimites and among the Manassites.

entries.title: Judges 12:5
segments: And the Gileadites took the fords of Jordan before the Ephraimites. And it happened that when one of those Ephraimites who had escaped said, Let me go over, the men of Gilead said to him, Are you an Ephraimite? And he said, No.

entries.title: Judges 12:6
segments: And they said to him, Please say Shibboleth. And he said, Sibboleth, for he could not manage to pronounce [it] right. Then they took him and killed him at the passages of Jordan. And there fell at that time forty-two thousand of the Ephraimites.

entries.title: Judges 12:7
segments: And Jephthah judged Israel six years. And Jephthah the Gileadite died, and was buried in [one of] the cities of Gilead.

entries.title: Judges 12:8
segments: And after him Ibzan of Bethlehem judged Israel.

entries.title: Judges 12:9
segments: And he had thirty sons and thirty daughters [whom] he sent abroad, and took in thirty daughters from abroad for his sons. And he judged Israel seven years.

entries.title: Judges 12:10
segments: Then Ibzan died, and was buried at Bethlehem.

entries.title: Judges 12:11
segments: And after him Elon, a Zebulonite, judged Israel. And he judged Israel ten years.

entries.title: Judges 12:12
segments: And Elon the Zebulonite died, and was buried in Aijalon, the land of Zebulun.

entries.title: Judges 12:13
segments: And after him Abdon the son of Hillel, a Pirathonite, judged Israel.

entries.title: Judges 12:14
segments: And he had forty sons and thirty grandsons, who rode on seventy ass colts. And he judged Israel eight years.

entries.title: Judges 12:15
segments: And Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died, and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the mount of the Amalekites.
